caption: Cheerful Brazilian children's pop song, extremely catchy singalong earworm, warm friendly adult male lead vocal with a kids choir answering the hook, bright and playful, clean polished mix, the hook starts right on the first beat with no intro, every section lasts exactly 4 bars, short repeated chorus, simple melody in small steps, call and response with the kids choir, the last chorus goes up by a whole step (key change), clear Portuguese pronunciation of every word, bubbly synth plucks, popping percussion sounds, ukulele, hand claps, bouncy bass, sparkly glockenspiel
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Pop, pop, pop, as bolhinhas vão estourar!
Pop, pop, pop, é hora de se ensaboar!
Esfrega o bracinho, esfrega o pezinho,
pop, pop, pop, fico limpinho!

[Verse 1]
Sabonete na mão, cheirinho de flor,
espuma na cabeça, que coisa de amor,
esfrega a barriguinha, esfrega as orelhinhas,
pop, pop, pop, bolhinhas!

[Chorus]
Pop, pop, pop, as bolhinhas vão estourar!
Pop, pop, pop, é hora de se ensaboar!
Esfrega o bracinho, esfrega o pezinho,
pop, pop, pop, fico limpinho!

[Verse 2]
Água morninha, que gostosa que é,
enxágua o corpinho, da cabeça ao pé,
pop, pop, pop, quanta espuma,
tchau, tchau, sujeirinha!

[Bridge]
Pop, pop, pop, pop, pop!
Pop, pop, pop, pop, pop!
Bolhinha pra lá, bolhinha pra cá,
pop!
